title.zh: 云部署平台Zeabur宣布逐步关停，曾遭两次安全攻击，12月31日前关闭全部服务器
title.en: 云部署平台Zeabur宣布逐步关停，曾遭两次安全攻击，12月31日前关闭全部服务器

current_state.zh: Cloud deployment platform Zeabur announced it will gradually shut down and close all dedicated servers and shared clusters by December 31 after a second security breach exposed sensitive user and service data.
current_state.en: Cloud deployment platform Zeabur announced it will gradually shut down and close all dedicated servers and shared clusters by December 31 after a second security breach exposed sensitive user and service data.
